work_arrangement: For a married couple with young children, both parents working full time and sharing childcare is usually best.

caregiver_parent: Which parent stays home shouldn't depend on sex; it should be whoever wants to or earns less.

marriage_decisions: Husbands and wives should make major family decisions equally.
Husbands and wives should decide equally, with each leading in different areas.

promote_marriage: Government shouldn't favor married people over unmarried people.
Government should only remove tax and benefit rules that penalize marriage, not actively promote it.

unmarried_partner_rights: Unmarried couples who live together should have the same legal rights as married couples, like inheritance and hospital visits.

childcare_spending: Government should spend enough to make care for children under 5 free for every family.

childcare_form: Help for families with young children should go mainly to childcare programs, so parents can work.

stay_home_support: Support should go to childcare so parents can work, not to parents who stay home.

no_fault_divorce: One spouse should be able to get a divorce without the other's agreement or proof of wrongdoing, as now.

pay_transparency: Employers with 100 or more workers should have to post pay ranges and report pay by gender to the government.

board_gender_rules: Public companies should be required to have at least 40% women on their boards.

workplace_gender_programs: Large employers should run programs with specific hiring targets for women and required training.

birth_rate_policy: Government shouldn't do anything about birth rates; having children is a personal choice.

women_draft: If there's a draft, women should be drafted on the same terms as men.
If there's a draft, women should be drafted only for non-combat roles.
If there's a draft, only men should be drafted.
natural_roles: Differences in men's and women's family roles come almost entirely from upbringing and culture.
